pages.contents: Methods for tumor mutational burden, whole exon sequencing, RNA-seq and the start of the TCRβ repertoire analysis section; includes alignment statistics and software versions.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Laboratory method description and sequencing quality statistics for paired tumor and blood samples; the tumor mutational burden and expression results themselves are in the main article and Table S1.
limitations: Sequencing quality statistics (percent mapped, mean depth, GC content) are not typed as patient facts because the sentences do not name the patient.

pages.contents: TCRβ sequencing method, clone-frequency definitions, unique productive rearrangement counts per sample, clone-tracking pattern definitions and the start of the reference list.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Method text with per-sample unique clone counts and tracking pattern definitions.

limitations: Clone-tracking pattern definitions and method details are not typed as clinical facts.

transcriptions.row_label: PBMC samples, haplotype, and immune cell population analysis
transcriptions.text: During CASVAC-0401 protocol, peripheral blood samples were obtained from patient #6 at 0 (PRE), 6, 12, and 24 months (POST1-3) from immunization with CSF-470 vaccine (1); a follow-up sample was obtained at 48 months), 2-years after completing the protocol (POST-4).

HLA haplotype was determined from PBMC by Scisco Genetics (2); presenting haplotype HLA-A*11:01; -A*25:01; -B*51:01; -B*57:01; -C*06:02; -C*15:02; -DPA1*01:03; -DPB1*02:01; DPB1*04:01; -DQA1*:02:01; -DQA1*:03:01; -DQB1*03:02; -DQB1*03:03; -DRB1*04:01; DRB1*07:01; -DRB345*01:01; -DRB345*01:03.

Unique nucleotide/aminoacid productive rearrangements (TCRβ clones) for each sample were: PBMC-PRE (60053/58491), PBMC-POST-1 (14681/14455), PBMC-POST-3 (65248/63852,), PBMC-POST-4 (209103/196336), TIL (1411/1382) (Supplementary tables 2-6).

ownership_evidence.quote: peripheral blood samples were obtained from patient #6

facts.notes: The HLA sentence does not itself name the patient; ownership rests on the preceding sentence of the same methods subsection about patient #6 PBMC samples.

ownership_evidence.quote: TCRβ sequence analyses were performed in the SC mts TIL and in PBMC samples obtained before (PBMC-PRE), during CSF-470 immunization (PBMC-POST-1 and PBMC-POST-3), and 2 years after completing the vaccine protocol (PBMC-POST-4)

facts.notes: Source prints nucleotide/amino acid counts as a slash pair; the first number is the nucleotide count and the second the amino acid count by the sentence wording. The sample name PBMC-POST-3 has a stray comma after the pair in the source.
